seam.name: MoE activation rotation and q8_1 quantize at hidden width 4608
seam.baseline_kernel: fwht.cu fwht_cuda_block<512, 256, float, true>: the transform, scale and sign multiply copied verbatim, one block per (row, 512-block), one launch
seam.candidate_kernel: bf16 wmma matmul against the signed block Hadamard, block 512, nine blocks, fp32 accumulate, one launch
seam.note: the butterfly body is the one fwht_siglu_q8_cuda runs (moe-fuse.cu moe_fwht_block_transform is a copy of fwht.cu's block transform); the SiLU gate and the q8_1 write are common to both arms, so only the q8_1 write is timed

shape.rotation: normalized block Hadamard, block 512, signed per input element

basis.note: stored int8, nine 512x512 blocks = 2.36 MB, L2-resident; the generated variant computes the signed Sylvester entry from the indices and reads no basis

verdict.reason: the tensor-core rotation with the basis read costs 18.617 us against the butterfly's 1.424 us at 23 rows (q8 chain 21.742 against 1.717); one coalesced pass over the basis alone costs 1.588 us, so no stored-basis kernel can beat the butterfly at this shape; the butterfly sits 0.480 us above a plain copy of the same bytes (0.944 us), the most any rotation kernel can save here
